text:
jordan: Heads-up — HealthFlow (pilot) just asked if we can onboard an open model 'ceres-8b' into EU + APAC private (VPC) with version pin v1.2-quant and quantized weights. They need region parity and a latency SLA ~120ms p50 for chat workloads. Can product triage?

emma: Noted. Do we have a perf profile for ceres-8b in our catalog? If not, we need a quick perf run + tokenizer sanity. Also clarify whether they need Dedicated or Private (they said private VPC).

jordan: They want Private (customer-managed VPC) to meet compliance. Sales says they're willing to commit to 2 reserved GPU nodes for 6 months if perf looks good — may convert to Dedicated later. Timeline target: 6 weeks.

raj: Security checklist: HealthFlow is healthcare. We'll need an initial privacy review + export control check. Also KMS integration confirmed? If private, customer will provide KMS or we need to support bringing-your-own.

lina: From infra side: we need to validate model supports our quant runtime (int8/awq). Who can run a quick end-to-end on a staging node to confirm memory/latency? If tokenization or special ops exist we may need a kernel fallback.

emma: Ok proposed intake plan: 1) perf & tokenization sanity on staging (P0) 2) security/compliance intake (P0) 3) implement pin + deploy package for v1.2-quant (P1) 4) create rollout plan for EU + APAC (canary -> regional baseline) 5) create cost estimate + reserved capacity pricing for sales. Launch criteria = perf within 120ms p50, privacy signoff, contract, and smoke tests pass.

jordan: I'll ask customer to provide representative prompts and target sequences (they have transcripts). Also confirm whether they rely on embeddings from same model or separate pipeline.

raj: Note — embedding API compatibility: ceres tokenizer emits special soft tokens; need check that our embedding pipeline doesn't drop them. If not compatible, we must provide guidance or a wrapper.

lina: Quick perf command you can run on staging: ```bash
./runtest --model ceres-8b:v1.2-quant --seq 512 --bench latency --warmup 20 --it 200
```
Include both nstream=1 and nstream=8. Capture p50/p95 and GPU mem.

emma: I'll add backlog ticket after we confirm perf. Proposed priority: P2 product intake with P0 tasks (perf/security). Jordan, can you attach contract signal (MOU) by EOD Friday? That affects prioritization.

jordan: Can do. Customer verbally committed to reserved nodes, MOU by Friday. Also asked about EU region pinning — wants immutable pin so they never silently upgrade.

raj: For immutable pin we must document supported patch policy and ensure our fallback rules are defined if a pinned binary fails. Ops needs a rollback plan.

lina: Capacity check: estimate 2x A100-ish nodes for target throughput? Need final perf numbers to size accurately. Also callout: APAC region has limited NVLink pools; might require special placement.

emma: Action items: @lina run perf on staging and post results here; @raj start security intake; @jordan attach prompts + MOU; I'll draft rollout + launch criteria and create backlog ticket (include customer, assigned eng, est). We'll aim for an intake meeting early next week.

deploy-bot: CI: perf-run job queued -> https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/ceres-8b/1937654321 (will post artifacts).

jordan: Thanks — I'll ping customer for test prompts and MOU. If perf is green we'll ask for signed PO to unlock priority. :thumbsup:

emma: Great. If anyone hits blockers, flag here and I'll escalate to eng leadership.
